Title: Ayaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ayaan - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vimla - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Riya - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ayaan: "And then?"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Ayaan (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Sonali: "Ayaan, are you okay?"

[Ayaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Ayaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Vimla: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan walks across the courtyard.]

Vimla: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan runs to Mother.]

Sonali: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Sonali: "That's easy."

[Ayaan climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Ayaan: "Grandma, are you okay?"

[Ayaan hides behind the tree.]

Ayaan: "I knew it!"

[Ayaan searches for his lost ball.]

Vimla (surprised): "That was fun!"

[Ayaan peeks out from behind the door.]

Sonali (surprised): "Ayaan, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Riya: "Yes, all right."

[Ayaan mops the floor.]

Ayaan (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Ayaan irons his school shirt.]

Riya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
